title: Headline Invaders
blurb: Headlines descend like invaders, and each racer's ship shoots the ones it calls clickbait while honest news lands on the front page.
lesson: A Noul gives a probability for every item, so Jev filters a stream of headlines quickly and shows how sure it was about each one.
why: Each headline gets one yes or no question with a sentence for each answer. Jev's Noul is a probability of yes, and Jev's laser glows brighter the surer it is.
Shooting an honest headline is friendly fire, and clickbait that lands cracks the front page. Count both kinds of mistake, not only the hits.
